title: Saint Charbel Prayer for Healing
purpose: Asking Saint Charbel's intercession for healing - the prayer most often said at his tomb in Annaya.
howToPray: Pray slowly, and put the person's name where the brackets are. There is no single fixed text you must use: name the person, ask his intercession, and trust God.
when: In any illness, your own or a loved one's; these prayers are also said daily at the tomb and within the Nine-Day Novena.
source: Original composition of marsharbel.com, written in the tradition of the Church's prayers of intercession.
